items.title: Download current or past theme versions
items.description: Need the latest — or a rollback? Grab any package from the portal. No support ticket.

items.title: All new features while licensed — no upsells
items.description: We keep shipping. You keep receiving — no upgrade tax.

items.title: Stay secure as WooCommerce changes
items.description: When WooCommerce or WordPress moves on, we ship fixes so you're not stuck on an outdated, risky setup.

items.title: Update instantly — no FTP or hassle
items.description: Update from WP admin in one click — or set it to auto. No FTP. No zip. No tech degree.

items.title: Manage your license in a dedicated portal
items.description: You're in charge. Activate, deactivate, move sites — no waiting on us.

items.title: Move your license between sites
items.description: Rebrand, migrate, or rebuild. Free a seat and activate on the new site — no stuck license.

items.title: Keep your license key safe in the portal
items.description: Stop digging through old emails. Your key lives in one secure place, anytime.

items.title: White-label the license on client websites
items.description: Clients see your work. Sensitive license stuff stays out of their way.

items.title: Remote license control on client sites
items.description: Turn a client's license on or off from the portal — no WordPress login needed.

items.title: Unlimited localhosts with active license
items.description: Spin up as many localhosts as you need — only live sites count.

items.title: Lock activations with a license firewall
items.description: Whitelist the sites that can use your key. Shared or leaked keys stop at the door.

items.title: Cancel or manage subscription yourself
items.description: You're in charge of billing. Change or cancel without chasing support.

items.title: Built for real shops — production-ready
items.description: Your store stays fast and maintainable. You get what a real shop needs — not a museum that fights every update.

items.title: Lean by design — no bloat
items.description: Designed light from the start, so you skip the cleanup bloated themes force on you.

items.title: Activate instantly — no setup drama
items.description: Click "Activate". You're in — no long setup ritual.

items.title: Use for your shop or a client's
items.description: Ship your store or a client's under the same rules. No gray area, no "is this allowed?" stress.

items.title: Get support from the people who built it
items.description: When something's wrong, you reach the humans who wrote the code.
